newsitem.title: USA: BDM Intl gets $115 mln govt contract.
newsitem.headline: BDM Intl gets $115 mln govt contract.

text.p: U.S. Justice Department has awarded BDM International Inc with a $115 million contract to provide it and other government agencies and departments with information technology support, the company said Friday.
Under the five-year contract, BDM said its subsidiary, BDM Federal Inc, will provide a system to allow the agencies and departments to manage information.
It said it had won a total of more than $1 billion in federal governemnt contracts this year, a record for the company.
